scope.search: GLOBAL discovery, REMOTE-FROM-INDIA employment, plus BENGALURU HYBRID

parameters.language_detection_confidence_threshold_: Not ruled (OI-023). Draft proposal in the spec: 0.95.

dimensions.separation_invariant: Eligibility, relevance, preference, newness and review are separate outputs. None is folded into another; there is no composite score.

TIER_2: AI Solutions Architect (only when genuinely hands-on)
title_families.TIER_3: Any other title whose JD contains substantial real AI-engineering work (e.g. Software Engineer - AI, Backend Engineer - GenAI, Platform Engineer - AI, Developer Productivity Engineer, Quality Engineering - GenAI, Test Engineering - AI/LLM, Data Engineer - RAG/LLM).

rules.description: Normalize Bengaluru aliases (Bengaluru, Bangalore, Bangalore Urban, Bengaluru Urban, Greater Bengaluru Area, Bengaluru East/North/South and any Bengaluru locality) to geo:city:IN-bengaluru via the geo alias table before any rule runs.
rules.evidence_required: Verbatim location span plus the alias-table entry that matched.
rules.notes: Bengaluru logic lives in geo/ data, not in gate code.

rules.description: Remote, worldwide.
rules.evidence_required: Quoted span stating remote with worldwide/anywhere eligibility.
supersedes: jobops-policy@0.1.0 WM-R1 (partially: remote no longer needs to be India-confirmed when worldwide)

rules.description: Remote with India explicitly eligible (e.g. 'Remote - India', 'India / US / UK', 'eligible countries including India', 'APAC (India, ...)').
rules.evidence_required: Quoted span naming India (or a geo alias resolving to India) among eligible locations.

rules.description: Remote region-locked to regions or countries that exclude India (US only, EU only, EEA only, UK only, ...).
rules.evidence_required: Quoted restriction span; the geo region table must show India outside the named region.
rules.notes: EMEA is not in the owner's example list; see OI-029.

rules.description: Posting requires authorization to work in another country and does not make India employment possible.
rules.evidence_required: Quoted work-authorization span (e.g. 'Must be authorized to work in the United States').

rules.description: Remote eligibility ambiguous (e.g. 'Remote - APAC' with India not named).
rules.evidence_required: Quoted span; recorded reason why India eligibility is not established.
rules.notes: APAC is never assumed to include India.

rules.description: Bengaluru hybrid with 0-3 office days per week.
rules.evidence_required: Quoted span stating hybrid and an office-day count <= 3; normalized city = Bengaluru.
supersedes: Career Strategy §4 Work Mode hard constraint

rules.description: Bengaluru hybrid with 4-5 office days per week.
Bengaluru hybrid, office days unspecified.
rules.evidence_required: Quoted hybrid span without a day count.

rules.description: Bengaluru 'flexible hybrid'.
Bengaluru onsite.
rules.evidence_required: Quoted onsite/work-from-office span; normalized city = Bengaluru.
rules.notes: Human-reviewable, not an automatic FAIL.

rules.description: Hybrid outside Bengaluru.
rules.evidence_required: Quoted hybrid span; normalized city is not Bengaluru.

rules.description: Onsite in India outside Bengaluru.
rules.evidence_required: Quoted onsite span; normalized city in India, not Bengaluru.

rules.description: Onsite abroad.
rules.evidence_required: Quoted onsite span; normalized country is not India.

rules.description: Relocation abroad required.
Visa-supported relocation.
No work-arrangement statement found in any observation.
rules.evidence_required: Record that the arrangement was sought and not found (absent, not not-captured).
rules.source: Owner Phase A specification §24 (unknown is not FAIL)
rules.notes: Carried from jobops-policy@0.1.0 WM-R5 and OR-03b's unknown-handling principle.

rules.description: Precedence inside geography: FAIL rules (R03, R04, R07, R11-R15) are checked before PASS rules; ambiguity (R05, R08, R09, R10, R16) yields UNKNOWN; a qualified phrase never resolves to PASS.
rules.notes: Mirrors the v0.1 discipline that ambiguous work-mode language never resolves to remote.

rules.description: Time-zone overlap requirements (US, UK, European, APAC, ...) are recorded as timezone_requirement, timezone_overlap_flag, detected_timezone and evidence. Never an eligibility verdict.
English-language posting with no other language required.
rules.evidence_required: Document language detection result, or a quoted working-language span.

rules.description: A non-English language is explicitly required ('German required', 'French mandatory').
A non-English language is nice-to-have / preferred / a bonus.
The entire JD is non-English and language detection is confident.
rules.evidence_required: detected_language, confidence, detector id and version, content_hash.

rules.description: Language detection is uncertain.

Record original_currency, original_amount (min/max), original_period, compensation_type (BASE | CTC | TOTAL | BONUS | EQUITY | UNSPECIFIED), base_or_total, and, when converted, fx_rate, fx_source, fx_snapshot_date, normalized_inr_annual_base.
rules.evidence_required: Verbatim compensation span plus the parse result.

rules.description: 'Up to X' is an upper bound only: min is not established.
rules.notes: Fixes audit finding C3 (policy/normalization.py:383-386 treated 'up to 30 LPA' as a point figure).

rules.description: Stated annual base clearly below ₹18L (range max < ₹18L, or point < ₹18L).
rules.evidence_required: Admissible figure: explicit point or range with currency and annual period.

rules.description: Stated annual base >= ₹24L (point, or range min >= ₹24L).
rules.notes: Preference band IN_TARGET_BAND (24-28L) or ABOVE_TARGET_BAND (>28L).

rules.description: Stated annual base >= ₹18L and < ₹24L (point, or range wholly inside [₹18L, ₹24L)).
rules.notes: Eligibility PASS. Preference BELOW_TARGET_BAND. Lane REVIEW. Never an eligibility failure.

rules.description: Range overlapping the ₹18L floor (e.g. ₹15-20L, ₹18-25L).
rules.notes: Owner example: ₹18-25L = UNKNOWN even though min equals the floor (OI-006).

rules.description: 'Up to ₹X' with no minimum.
Compensation undisclosed.
rules.evidence_required: Record that compensation was sought and not found.
rules.notes: Reaffirms OR-03b.

rules.description: Variable, unclear or non-numeric compensation ('competitive', 'as per industry').
Only equity, stock, bonus, commission or sign-on information is given.
India CTC is stored as compensation_type = CTC and never silently treated as gross base.
rules.notes: How a CTC figure compares with the ₹18L/₹24L thresholds is not ruled (OI-007).

rules.description: When the posting gives an India-specific band, that band is used, even if other country bands are present.
Foreign posting with location-adjusted pay and no India-specific band.
rules.notes: The foreign number is never assumed to be the India offer.

rules.description: Foreign annual base is converted to INR with a dated weekly FX snapshot and compared against the single ₹18L floor and ₹24L target; no separate USD/EUR floors.
rules.evidence_required: fx_rate, fx_source, fx_snapshot_date recorded on the evaluation.
supersedes: OQ-02 (non-INR -> UNKNOWN while no FX source is configured)
rules.notes: Until R2 is confirmed AND an FX source exists, non-INR figures remain UNKNOWN (COMP-UNKNOWN-NO-INR-BASIS behaviour of v0.1). No live FX fetching in any phase before P1 implementation.

rules.description: Non-annual figure without a stated annualization basis.
rules.source: Owner Phase A specification carried from OQ-02

rules.description: Permanent direct employment.
Plain full-time.
Contract.
supersedes: Career Strategy §4 Employment Type (contract acceptable if >= 6 months at a product company)

rules.description: Contract-to-hire.
Temporary.
Freelance.
Part-time.
Internship.
Short-term contract: stated duration < short_term_contract_months (default 6).
rules.notes: Threshold configurable: parameters.short_term_contract_months.

rules.description: Long-term (>= threshold) contract directly with the hiring company.
rules.evidence_required: Quoted span showing direct engagement and duration.

rules.description: Mixed wording ('Full-Time / Contractual').
Employment type unstated.
rules.evidence_required: Record that it was sought and not found.

rules.description: Permanent employment through a genuine Employer of Record while working for the hiring company.
rules.notes: EOR is never collapsed into staffing/placement.

rules.description: Direct employment by the hiring company.
rules.evidence_required: Employer is the hiring company; no third-party relationship stated.

rules.description: Independent contractor.
B2B engagement.
Invoice-based engagement.
Hourly contractor.
Staffing agency hires and places the candidate at another client.
supersedes: OR-04 (staffing is not a veto) for the placement case

rules.description: Third-party payroll / body-shopping placement.
Staffing/placement agency is the employer and the relationship is not yet sufficiently known.
rules.evidence_required: Quoted span or registry classification STAFFING.

rules.description: Employer classified STAFFING.
Employer classified CONSULTANCY.
Employer classified IT_SERVICES.
rules.notes: IT services companies are never failed wholesale.

rules.description: Employer unclassified / unknown.
Employer classified PRODUCT, AI_NATIVE, GCC or ENGINEERING_LED.
rules.notes: Also yields a positive preference signal (PREF-R02).

rules.description: An owner-confirmed classification overrides an inferred one.
JD asks 2-3 years, exactly 3 years, or '3+' years.
JD asks 4-6 years.
JD asks 7+ years.
JD experience unspecified.
rules.evidence_required: Record that it was sought and not found.

rules.description: REASONABLE: definition not provided by the owner (e.g. 2-5, 3-5 years).
Experience is never an eligibility veto.
Senior / Lead / Staff / Principal / Architect are recorded as seniority signals and never cause FAIL or automatic PARKED.
Title is a weak prior: Tier 1 (primary family), Tier 2 (adjacent AI engineering), Tier 3 (other titles with substantial AI work), NONE.
The JD is the primary evidence; no job is rejected for a non-matching title.
Relevance label STRONG | MODERATE | WEAK, with evidence spans per capability cluster A-F.
rules.evidence_required: At least one quoted span per claimed cluster; relevance_label, capability_clusters, title_signal, experience_signal, confidence, evaluator/model/prompt versions.

rules.description: Concrete engineering evidence is required; generic mentions ('experience with AI tools') alone cannot yield STRONG or MODERATE.
AI Quality involving LLM/RAG/agent evaluation, hallucination/groundedness, AI observability is in the target universe; traditional QA without substantial AI engineering is generally WEAK.
Relevance never produces an eligibility FAIL.
LLM output is evidence extraction/classification only; store model_id, prompt_version, content_hash.
No JD text available (title/snippet only): relevance_label = NOT_ASSESSED.
compensation_band: BELOW_TARGET_BAND (₹18L to <₹24L), IN_TARGET_BAND (₹24-28L), ABOVE_TARGET_BAND (>₹28L), UNKNOWN, NOT_APPLICABLE (compensation FAIL).
rules.notes: Preferred band ₹24-28L; expected ask ₹26L. Never anchor to ₹16L.

rules.description: employer_preference: PREFERRED_PRODUCT | PREFERRED_AI_NATIVE | PREFERRED_GCC | PREFERRED_ENGINEERING_LED | NEUTRAL | UNKNOWN.
No composite 'fit' or 'best job' score exists. Preference is never an eligibility veto.
FAIL dominates UNKNOWN dominates PASS across geography, language, compensation, employment_type, employment_relationship, employer_type.
rules.notes: Carried from jobops-policy@0.1.0 verdicts.precedence (OR-04, P0_SPEC §3.4).

rules.description: Requisition resolved as a canonical duplicate -> SUPPRESSED_DUPLICATE.
Any eligibility FAIL -> EXCLUDED.
No FAIL and relevance WEAK -> PARKED.
rules.notes: Seniority, 7+ years or foreign origin never park a STRONG role.

rules.description: No FAIL, relevance STRONG/MODERATE, and at least one UNKNOWN dimension or review-routing flag -> REVIEW.
No FAIL, relevance STRONG/MODERATE, no UNKNOWN, no review-routing flag -> SHORTLIST.
Relevance NOT_ASSESSED -> lane not ruled.
Daily REVIEW cap = parameters.review_daily_cap (10). SHORTLIST uncapped.
REVIEW overflow carries forward up to parameters.review_carry_days (3) days, then unresolved low-priority items move to PARKED and appear in the weekly digest.
REVIEW ordering is deterministic: ordered categorical keys, then stable tie-breakers; no composite score.
Newness states NEW | UPDATED | SEEN_BEFORE per canonical requisition, with first_seen_at, last_seen_at, source_first_seen_at, date_precision, newness_confidence, source_observations.
Sightings of the same requisition across LinkedIn, employer ATS, company site, Naukri and other boards are ONE canonical requisition with multiple observations.
Employer requisition URL is preferred as the canonical identity URL.
Suppression-grade identity: same source id (L1), same canonical URL (L2), same ATS system+tenant+requisition (L4), including an apply URL that resolves to an ATS requisition.
rules.notes: Carried from identity/jobops-identity-0.1.0.json layers.

rules.description: Company + title + normalized location match (after geo aliasing) without a suppression-grade key -> PROBABLE_DUPLICATE, IDENTITY_UNCERTAIN, human confirms.
rules.notes: Changes identity@0.1.0 DR-L3-LOCATION outcomes once geo aliasing exists; requires an identity ruleset version bump.

rules.description: Evaluation key = (requisition_id, policy_version, evidence_hash). An existing key is reused, never recomputed into a second record.
Current evaluation is computed from the per-dimension richest valid evidence across all observations, never from the newest observation alone.
rules.notes: Explicit fix for audit finding F4.

rules.description: Absent / not-captured evidence never displaces present evidence.
rules.notes: Generalizes ingestion/merge.py 'nothing never overwrites something' across observations.

rules.description: Evidence precedence per dimension: (1) owner-confirmed company classification [employer_type only]; (2) source authority tier; (3) evidence class; (4) observation completeness; (5) recency among equals. Conflicting explicit statements across tiers set SOURCE_CONFLICT.
rules.source: Owner Phase A specification §27 (precedence to be defined)
